meta_state_law_citations_007.answer: In keeping with the goal of maximizing instructional time, the District will mandate only essential assessments over and above those mandated by statute or rule from PED. Aligning APS practices with the state administrative code definitions of the scope of school psychologist practice and national professional practice models for school psychology.
